prep.summary:
Payments remain deployed and stable in `2.8.0-rc.3`: the production migration succeeded, all four replicas are healthy, and billing tests passed (18 passed, 1 skipped because the Stripe sandbox was unavailable). Payment failure logs include invoice IDs while preserving `PaymentError`, export/bucket behavior, and secret safety. Broader reconciliation and voided-versus-cancelled invoice semantics remain deferred.

The main broader objective is still narrow, immutable tenant audit events for the admin activity feed, while preserving legacy CSV exports and existing export, credit, payment-event, and event-sourcing behavior. Currency/rounding fixtures, backdating documentation, proration/pauses, recurring tax redesign, scheduling enhancements, and provider error categorization are deferred. Future posted-versus-pending status and CLI wording are only informal interests. A possible ledger dependency visualization is not yet part of the active scope; the legacy XML importer may eventually be retired.

The health-log assertion now expects `request_id`, and its targeted suite passes all four tests. A fresh full suite run is still worthwhile because the previous run had 142 passed, 3 skipped, and only that stale assertion failing.

A real scheduler DST defect was fixed by resolving the schedule’s timezone before converting to UTC. All eight scheduler tests pass, including a spring-forward regression test. A new regression assertion now verifies that the generated UTC instant and its `America/New_York` wall time match the requested post-transition schedule. Existing `None` timezone and end-of-month behavior remain intact, and `zoneinfo` still raises for unknown IANA zones.
